purpose: A fetch stand-in for the GilbPlatform that answers the platform's real routes with the platform's real shapes, holding its state in memory, for an app's tests.
namedChanges: 0.1.2. new row 21, `POST /base/style/extract` (src/style.ts): credential first (401 before the body), body limit 4096 bytes (413), schema, 10 per 60 s per principal on the fake's clock (429 `rate_limited`), `bad_url` and `address_not_allowed` 400, the answer seeded by `seedStyle(url, result)` or a stub of the address; `FakeState.style`; the row was read at GilbPlatform 0d602ce8995dc672f241aff5e276f03b98dbad1b, newer than `PLATFORM_SHA`
0.1.1. create-named refuses a parentVault the caller did not mint (403, the platform's sentence; Vault.mintedBy); tests for the htu check on an encoded vault path; four stale client tests updated
New code, written for EESpeed Round 5 (R5-C3). 0.1.0 holds parts 1 to 3: the core, the DPoP check, the vault list, the record routes, files, grants, sign-in, check-name and create-named.

library.title: Fake platform (test stand-in: sign-in, records, files, grants)
library.note: For tests only, never in an app's shipped code: it keeps state in memory and checks no signatures. To call the platform take lws-records, signin, picture-set or vault-access. Refuses a parentVault the caller did not mint, as the platform does.
